change_from_v1.rationale: B04V2 development evidence showed a formulation whose local execution search produced positive 24-block gross and net, followed by negative full-train gross with broad support. This is distinguishable from 'never found gross basin' and should first trigger observable context/regime reformulation rather than generic mechanism replacement.

rules.condition: court.formal_eligible == true and novelty.status in {NEW, DUPLICATE}

constructibility.status == PASS and active_assets is known and active_assets < 12, OR EXTENDED24 active_block_fraction is known and active_block_fraction < 0.25, OR FULLTRAIN active_time_fraction is known and active_time_fraction < 0.02
evaluation_stage == FULLTRAIN and current gross_sum <= 0 and local_search.best_prior_gross_sum > 0 and local_search.best_prior_net_sum > 0 and active_time_fraction >= 0.75
rules.note: A previously viable replicated realization lost gross edge when the same formulation was expanded over the full train state space. Calendar month/year identities are forbidden context variables; only PIT-safe contemporaneous state may be used.

rules.condition: decision_epochs_in_current_formulation >= 2 and window_summary.best_gross_sum is known and best_gross_sum <= 0
gross_positive == true and net_positive == false and cost_exceeds_gross == true and adequate_support == true
rules.adequate_support_definition: active_assets >= 12 and ((EXTENDED24 and active_block_fraction >= 0.75) or (FULLTRAIN and active_time_fraction >= 0.02))

rules.condition: evaluation_stage == EXTENDED24 and active_block_fraction >= 0.75 and positive_month_pair_means is known and positive_month_pair_means <= 2
optimizer_active == true and (gross_improvement > 0 or net_improvement > 0) and no higher-priority trigger fired
optimizer_active == true and stagnation_steps >= 2 and no higher-priority trigger fired

action_payload_policy.selection_rule: Generate the requested intervention deterministically from the current byte-bound formulation state and replicate payload seed; apply it through the frozen formulation runtime; reject any payload whose required identity delta is absent or whose actual delta exceeds the predeclared allowed secondary dimensions. CHANGE_MECHANISM/ABANDON advance through the deterministic unused-family permutation.

remaining_external_launch_blockers: final umbrella PAPER_V1_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT binding the already-frozen provider-neutral controller/data/evaluator contracts
